answer_1.quote: The main task of conditional natural language generation (CNLG) is to provide freedom to control the output text… We focus on the task of generating such emotionally connotated event descriptions.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the performance of the generation models, we calculate F1 with automatic emotion and appraisal classifiers … perplexity is also reported as a quality measure.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human study to validate the automatic evaluation… The survey consists of 23 statements to be rated on a five-level Likert scale, covering emotions, appraisal variables, and text quality.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rate 23 statements on a five‑level Likert scale covering emotion, appraisal, and text quality criteria.
